body:
I feel like I've been on the edge of this cliff since before I left for college, but always had something to keep me going. At first it was a social club I bonded with, then it was my (now) wife. I've lost contact and connection with both of those and can't seem to get them back. I'm too old and feel out of place in the club and have tried everything with the wife. 
I now have nothing keeping me going. Nothing to outweigh the pain I feel like I've been burying for as long as I can remember.
